He's 69 years old and still splits his own firewood by hand.

I met him in Montana back in 1971. Every single morning, same hour, 
before he touches the axe — he eats a bowl of this deep purple 
gelatin.

Three ingredients. That's it. But he's very particular about the 
order, and he never mixes the blueberries in while it's still hot.

I wrote down his exact measurements the way he does it.

Type RECIPE in the comments and I'll send it to you on Messenger.
